name: LoadingRackSlotScheduler
tagline: Fuel terminal rack slots, gate queue, compartments and lifting allocation in one Power Platform control.
description: A complete loading rack app for fuel terminals and depots: bay-by-hour rack board with drag-to-move, gate check-in and queue, multi-compartment tank-truck plans, metered volume and BOL on completion, daily customer lifting allocations and a carrier scorecard. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages, starts with demo data and connects to any data source in a few clicks.
features: Bay × hour rack board with drag-and-drop and keyboard moves
Clash, rack-hours, bay-product and allocation checks before confirming
Gate check-in by plate with driver access-card check
Queue → loading → gate-out with estimated loading time
Compartment plan editor with truck capacity meter
Complete load with metered volume, tolerance warning and BOL
Bulk status changes, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and OnSave / OnCreate / OnStatusChange events
Phone layout with bay agenda and bottom navigation
